extraction_guidelines.entity_type_selection: Choose from EntityType enum. If uncertain, use 'Other'.
extraction_guidelines.relation_type_selection: Choose from RelationType enum. Avoid generic 'related_to' unless no better option.
extraction_guidelines.confidence_scoring: 1.0 = explicitly stated in text, 0.8 = inferred with high certainty, 0.5 = inferred with low certainty
extraction_guidelines.source_format: Document name (e.g., IPC, CPC) and section/article number if applicable
key_relationships: Legal documents heavily use: defines, part_of, establishes, specifies, amends, enforces, interprets, cited_in
Procedural documents use: procedure_for, prerequisite_to, precedes, followed_by
Definitional sections use: defines, defined_in, classifies, is_instance_of
Temporal/validity relations use: amends, amended_by, supersedes, repeals
Enforcement relations use: enforces, enforced_by, interprets, adjudicates
Citation relations use: cited_in, cites, referenced_in, references
